simple.prompt: Formal replacement for phrasal verb 'look into': 'The parliamentary ombudsman agreed to ___ the public grievances.'
simple.explanation: Dalam ragam formal/akademis, verba tunggal Latinate ('investigate') lebih diutamakan daripada phrasal verb percakapan ('look into').
hints: Pilih kata kerja tunggal Latinate formal.

simple.prompt: Formal replacement for 'get rid of': 'The corporation decided to ___ its underperforming assets.'
simple.explanation: 'Divest' adalah istilah bisnis/keuangan resmi yang bermartabat untuk melepaskan atau menjual aset.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat formal pengganti 'We asked for more money'.
simple.targetSentence: The department requested additional budgetary allocations.
simple.explanation: The department + requested (verba formal) + additional budgetary allocations (frasa formal).
hints: Predikat dan objek formal: 'requested additional budgetary allocations'.

simple.prompt: Formal replacement for 'a lot of': 'The initiative attracted ___ international support.'
simple.explanation: Dalam ragam formal, gunakan 'considerable', 'substantial', atau 'significant' sebagai pengganti kata santai 'a lot of / tons of'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat formal pengganti 'The boss fired him'.
simple.targetSentence: The management terminated his employment contract.
simple.explanation: The management + terminated (formal) + his employment contract.

simple.prompt: Formal replacement for 'put off': 'The committee voted to ___ the annual general meeting.'
simple.explanation: Gunakan 'postpone' atau 'defer' sebagai padanan resmi 'put off'.

simple.targetSentence: I am writing to inquire about the scholarship requirements.
simple.explanation: I am writing to inquire + about the scholarship requirements.
hints: Mulai dengan pembuka surat formal: 'I am writing to inquire'.

simple.prompt: Replace the informal phrasal verb in 'We need to look into the billing discrepancy' with the formal Latinate single verb:
simple.explanation: Tulisan formal dan bisnis profesional mengganti phrasal verb 'look into' dengan kata kerja serapan Latin satu kata yang presisi: 'investigate'.
hints: Cari padanan satu kata yang baku untuk laporan formal.

simple.prompt: In formal correspondence, replace 'Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner' with:
options: I apologize for the delay in responding to your message.
My bad for ghosting your email earlier.
No worries about waiting so long for my reply.
simple.explanation: Email resmi menggunakan ungkapan sopan baku ('I apologize for the delay in responding...') dan menghindari bahasa slang atau kontraksi kasual.

simple.prompt: Choose the formal equivalent of 'a lot of delays' for an executive report:
simple.explanation: 'Tons of' dan 'loads of' hanya untuk percakapan santai; laporan resmi memakai 'numerous' atau 'considerable'.

simple.prompt: Which sentence strictly follows the rule against contractions in formal academic/legal documents?
options: The agency does not authorize unverified third-party downloads.
The agency doesn't authorize unverified third-party downloads.
The agency won't let you download stuff from third parties.
simple.explanation: Dalam makalah akademik, kontrak, dan laporan resmi, bentuk penuh tanpa singkatan ('does not', 'cannot', 'will not') diwajibkan.
hints: Hindari bentuk singkatan dengan apostrof seperti 'doesn't' dan 'won't'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi pembukaan surat resmi kepada penerima yang namanya belum diketahui.
dialogue: Intern
What salutation should open a formal inquiry when I only know the committee title?
Mentor
Write 'Dear Selection Committee,' or '___,' and close with 'Yours faithfully,' if unnamed.
simple.explanation: Bila nama penerima surat resmi tidak diketahui, gunakan 'Dear Sir or Madam,' atau jabatan resmi ('Dear Admissions Committee,'), bukan sapaan kasual.
hints: Sapaan formal tanpa nama penerima memakai bentuk baku.

simple.prompt: Replace the informal marker 'Anyway, back to the point...' in a business memo with:
options: To return to the primary matter,
simple.explanation: Penanda wacana formal mengarahkan fokus kembali ke topik utama dengan frasa profesional seperti 'To return to the primary matter,' atau 'Regarding the core issue,'.
hints: Cari transisi memo bisnis yang rapi dan objektif.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki benturan gaya bahasa (register clash) kasual di tengah kalimat laporan formal berikut.
simple.draft: The board reviewed every quarterly projection, and basically the numbers look pretty awesome.
options: The board reviewed every quarterly projection, and overall the figures appear highly promising.
The board reviewed every quarterly projection, and basically the numbers look super awesome.
The board checked out every quarterly projection, and the numbers look pretty awesome.
simple.explanation: 'Basically', 'numbers look', dan 'pretty awesome' merusak nada objektif laporan dewan direksi; ganti dengan kosa kata formal konsisten ('overall', 'figures appear', 'highly promising').
hints: Ubah seluruh elemen ke ragam profesional yang seragam.

simple.prompt: Replace 'cut down on waste' in an environmental policy brief with the formal verb phrase:
simple.explanation: 'Reduce' atau 'curtail' adalah padanan formal standar bagi phrasal verb kasual 'cut down on'.
hints: Ganti phrasal verb 'cut down on' dengan kata kerja tunggal formal.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat penutup email bisnis formal yang santun.
simple.targetSentence: Please let us know if you require any additional clarification regarding this invoice.
simple.explanation: Menggunakan 'require' dan 'clarification regarding' membangun nada sopan profesional tanpa singkatan.
hints: Awali dengan 'Please let us know if you require'.
Tambahkan objek dan frasa 'regarding this invoice'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan formal tanpa kontraksi memakai 'cannot'.
simple.targetSentence: Preliminary test results cannot be generalized beyond coastal mangrove zones.
simple.explanation: Dalam tulisan formal, 'cannot' ditulis serangkai tanpa spasi dan tanpa apostrof.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Preliminary test results cannot be'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog peningkatan register bahasa komunikasi eksekutif.
dialogue: Junior Staff
We need to fix this problem right away or we'll lose clients.
Senior Partner
Let us formulate it professionally: 'We must ___ this operational deficiency to preserve client retention.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Rectify' adalah padanan presisi dalam register tinggi untuk 'fix/solve a deficiency'.

intermediate.prompt: Avoiding colloquial contractions: In formal institutional reporting, which form is strictly expected?
intermediate.explanation: Penulisan dokumen institusional resmi dan jurnal akademik mewajibkan penulisan kata utuh tanpa singkatan (contractions): 'does not', bukan 'doesn't'.

intermediate.prompt: Formal connective: 'The firm sustained financial losses; ___, shareholder confidence remained intact.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Nonetheless' / 'Nevertheless' adalah penanda wacana tingkat tinggi yang menggantikan kata santai 'anyway'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat formal pengganti 'We don't agree with the price'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We have substantial reservations regarding the proposed valuation.
intermediate.explanation: We have substantial reservations + regarding the proposed valuation.

intermediate.prompt: Formal epistemic formula: 'I think the plan is flawed' -> 'In our assessment, the proposal contains ___ structural flaws.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Consequential structural flaws' menyampaikan dampak yang signifikan secara analitis dan tenang.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penutup korespondensi diplomatik resmi.
intermediate.targetSentence: We look forward to receiving your favorable response.
intermediate.explanation: We look forward to receiving + your favorable response.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We look forward to receiving'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perumusan tanggapan terhadap keluhan regulator.
dialogue: CEO
How should we respond to the compliance breach letter?
General Counsel
We must formally ___ receipt and commit to a comprehensive internal audit.
intermediate.explanation: 'Acknowledge receipt' adalah formula standar hukum perbankan dan diplomasi.
hints: Istilah hukum resmi mengakui penerimaan surat.

intermediate.prompt: Replace the conversational phrasal verb 'put up with' in 'Hospital staff should not have to put up with outdated triage software' with:
intermediate.explanation: Padanan kata tunggal Latinate yang tepat dan formal untuk 'put up with' adalah 'tolerate' atau 'endure'.
hints: Cari padanan formal bermakna menoleransi keadaan buruk.

intermediate.prompt: In formal policy writing, replace the vague noun 'things' in 'Several things slowed down customs clearance' with a precise lexical item:
intermediate.explanation: Tulisan formal menuntut ketepatan leksikal (lexical precision): hindari kata hampa 'things/stuff' dan ganti dengan 'factors', 'issues', atau 'bottlenecks'.
hints: 'Things' dan 'stuff' terlalu kabur untuk laporan formal.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi mengenai alasan menghindari gaya bahasa terlalu bombastis (over-formal pompousness).
dialogue: Student
Should I write 'endeavor to ascertain the veracity of' instead of 'try to verify'?
Editor
No! Good formal register prioritizes ___ rather than archaic, bloated synonyms.
options: the longest possible Latin dictionary words
eliminating every active verb in favor of passives
intermediate.explanation: Register formal modern (seperti gaya The Economist atau jurnal top) mengutamakan kejelasan, ketepatan istilah, dan keringkasan elegan ('verify'), bukan bahasa kuno yang berlagak rumit.
hints: Bahasa formal bukan berarti kata-kata kuno yang bertele-tele.

intermediate.prompt: Which sentence avoids colloquial speech fillers and vague endings ('etc.', 'and so on', 'kind of') cleanly?
options: The audit examined inventory controls, vendor contracts, and payroll disbursements.
The audit checked inventory, vendor stuff, and so on.
The audit kind of looked at contracts, payroll, etc.
intermediate.explanation: Menyebut daftar tertutup atau menggunakan 'including X, Y, and Z' jauh lebih presisi daripada mengakhiri kalimat formal dengan 'stuff' atau 'and so on'.
hints: Hilangkan akhiran malas 'and so on / etc.' serta 'kind of'.
Daftar tiga elemen paralel tanpa singkatan santai.

intermediate.prompt: Replace 'come up with a plan' in an annual executive summary with:
intermediate.explanation: 'Formulate a strategy' atau 'devise a plan' memberikan kesan profesionalisme tinggi daripada 'come up with' atau idiom slang 'cook up'.
hints: Cari verb formal untuk merancang rencana.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting benturan register antara frasa hukum berat dan idiom slang pada kalimat memo berikut.
intermediate.draft: Pursuant to Clause 7.4 of the master lease, all tenants must cough up the maintenance deposit by Monday.
options: Pursuant to Clause 7.4 of the master lease, all tenants must remit the maintenance deposit by Monday.
Pursuant to Clause 7.4 of the master lease, all tenants gotta cough up the maintenance deposit by Monday.
Hey tenants, pursuant to Clause 7.4, cough up the maintenance deposit by Monday.
intermediate.explanation: Memadukan istilah hukum 'Pursuant to Clause 7.4' dengan idiom slang 'cough up' (= menyerahkan uang dengan terpaksa) menciptakan register clash mencolok; ganti dengan kata kerja resmi 'remit' atau 'submit'.
hints: 'Cough up' adalah idiom slang yang bertabrakan keras dengan 'Pursuant to Clause 7.4'.

intermediate.prompt: Which transition best introduces a concluding synthesis in an academic essay?
options: In summary, targeted insulation lowers urban cooling demand.
So yeah, at the end of the day, insulation helps a lot.
To wrap this thing up, insulation works okay.
intermediate.explanation: 'In summary,' atau 'In conclusion,' menjaga objektivitas penutup esai, sedangkan 'at the end of the day' dan 'works okay' bersifat lisan.
hints: Pilih penutup paragraf akademik yang bebas klise lisan.

intermediate.prompt: Convert 'The system got hacked last night' into an appropriately formal incident report opening:
options: An unauthorized intrusion compromised the system overnight.
Some hacker totally broke into our boxes last night.
The system got kind of messed up overnight.
intermediate.explanation: Mengganti kata kerja kasual 'got + V3' ('got hacked') dengan nomina/verba formal ('An unauthorized intrusion compromised...') langsung mengangkat kredibilitas laporan insiden.
hints: Hindari pola percakapan 'got + V3' dalam laporan resmi.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat formal tanpa phrasal verb kasual untuk menyatakan pembatalan.
intermediate.targetSentence: Organizers cancelled the coastal regatta owing to severe crosswinds.
intermediate.explanation: Memilih 'cancelled' (bukan 'called off') dan 'owing to' (bukan 'because of weird winds') menjaga nada berita resmi.
hints: Awali dengan 'Organizers cancelled the coastal regatta'.
Tambahkan alasan formal 'owing to severe crosswinds'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka formal yang mengganti 'ask for' dengan 'request'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Municipal engineers requested additional hydrological surveys prior to tunnel excavation.
intermediate.explanation: 'Requested ... prior to' menggantikan bahasa lisan 'asked for ... before'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Municipal engineers requested additional hydrological surveys'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi inkonsistensi register (register clash) yang mencampurkan bahasa hukum kaku dengan bahasa gaul percakapan.
complex.draft: The defendant acknowledges that he breached the confidentiality accord, which was totally not cool.
options: The defendant acknowledges that he breached the confidentiality accord, an action that constituted a material violation of the agreement.
The defendant acknowledges that he breached the accord, which was pretty bad.
The defendant says he broke the agreement, which was totally not cool.
complex.explanation: Frasa gaul 'which was totally not cool' adalah register clash ekstrem dalam konteks hukum. Kalimat harus diselaraskan ke dalam register yuridis murni: 'an action that constituted a material violation of the agreement'.
hints: Hilangkan bahasa santai dan selaraskan dengan register hukum murni.

complex.prompt: Defining feature of formal register in Anglo-American professional rhetoric:
options: Syntactic complexity, emotional restraint, precision of Latinate vocabulary, and objective thematic progression.
Arbitrary use of archaic Shakespearean vocabulary.
Using capitalized exclamation marks on every sentence.
complex.explanation: Register formal dicirikan oleh kendali emosional (restraint), presisi kosakata Latinate, struktur sintaksis yang mapan, dan progres informasi yang objektif.
hints: Karakteristik register formal: kendali emosi, presisi, dan objektivitas.
Pilih opsi syntactic complexity, emotional restraint, precision.

complex.prompt: Formality of address in official memoranda: Which greeting represents impeccably restrained executive protocol?
options: Dear Members of the Oversight Committee,
To whom it might concern or whoever reads this,
complex.explanation: 'Dear Members of the Oversight Committee,' mempertahankan kesopanan, rasa hormat, dan ketertiban protokol institusi.
hints: Pilih opsi 'Dear Members of the Oversight Committee,'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat resolusi dewan direksi berbobot formal tinggi.
complex.targetSentence: The board resolved to authorize the immediate disbursement of capital.
complex.explanation: The board resolved to authorize + the immediate disbursement of capital.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The board resolved to authorize'.
Frasa nominal resmi: 'the immediate disbursement of capital'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi gaya bahasa subjektif-emosional dalam ringkasan eksekutif audit.
complex.draft: The CFO was amazingly terrible at managing the budget, causing chaos everywhere.
options: The CFO demonstrated severe deficiencies in fiscal governance, resulting in pervasive operational disarray.
The CFO was really bad at managing money, causing widespread panic.
The CFO did an awful job with money, which was a real mess.
complex.explanation: Teks formal menghindari penilaian emosional subjektif ('amazingly terrible'). Gunakan evaluasi faktual berbobot: 'demonstrated severe deficiencies in fiscal governance, resulting in pervasive operational disarray'.
hints: Ubah bahasa subjektif menjadi analisis objektif dan profesional.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence written in flawless, uncompromised diplomatic register:
options: The government expresses its profound regret regarding the maritime incident and reaffirms its adherence to international sovereignty.
The government is super sorry about what happened at sea and will play by the rules.
Our government feels really bad about the sea problem and wants to be friends.
complex.explanation: Formula diplomasi baku menggunakan 'profound regret', 'maritime incident', dan 'reaffirms its adherence to international sovereignty'.

dialogue: Managing Partner
Should we issue a warning to opposing counsel regarding their dilatory tactics?
Senior Associate
Yes. We should advise them that further delays will compel us to ___ judicial sanctions.
complex.explanation: 'Petition the court for' adalah terminologi litigasi peradilan resmi untuk mengajukan permohonan sanksi kepada hakim.

complex.prompt: Identify the subtle register issue in this sentence: 'Whilst our data corroborate Dr. Sato's model, one can clearly see it doesn't hold up in arid zones.'
options: The informal contraction 'doesn't' and phrasal 'hold up' clash with the formal 'Whilst' and 'corroborate'
Subject 'data' cannot pair with plural verb 'corroborate'
'In arid zones' requires a colon before it
complex.explanation: Dalam penguasaan register tingkat lanjut, konsistensi jauh lebih penting daripada sekadar menyelipkan satu kata bergengsi ('Whilst', 'corroborate') lalu terjatuh ke kontraksi ('doesn't') dan phrasal verb lisan ('hold up') — ganti menjadi 'does not apply / remain valid'.
hints: Perhatikan kontras mencolok antara 'Whilst / corroborate' dan 'doesn't hold up'.
Hilangkan kontraksi dan ganti phrasal verb lisan.

complex.prompt: Which formal sentence handles gender-neutral and impersonal reference most gracefully without clumsy repetition?
options: Applicants must submit their portfolios prior to the interview.
An applicant must always bring his portfolio, or his/her portfolio if applicable, before he/she interviews.
Every single applicant has got to hand in their stuff early.
complex.explanation: Mengubah subjek ke bentuk jamak ('Applicants must submit their portfolios') adalah solusi paling rapi dan elegan dalam gaya editorial modern untuk menghindari he/she yang canggung sekaligus menjaga formalitas.
hints: Subjek jamak ('Applicants ... their') menghindari 'his/her' yang bertele-tele.
Bandingkan kerapian pilihan pertama dengan lainnya.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan ungkapan klise jurnalistik dan kata kerja informal dalam abstrak ilmiah berikut.
complex.draft: Last but not least, our research puts forward a brand-new way to figure out glacier melt rates.
options: Finally, this study proposes a novel methodology for estimating glacier melt rates.
Last but not least, our research comes up with a cool new way to figure out glacier melt rates.
At the end of the day, our research proposes a brand-new methodology to figure out melt rates.
complex.explanation: Dalam abstrak jurnal ilmiah: ganti klise pidato 'Last but not least' → 'Finally'; 'puts forward' → 'proposes'; 'brand-new way' → 'novel methodology'; dan 'figure out' → 'estimating'.
hints: Identifikasi semua elemen lisan/klise: 'Last but not least', 'brand-new way', 'figure out'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penyuntingan mengenai mengapa kalimat aktif formal tetap sering lebih baik daripada pasif bertele-tele.
dialogue: Reviewer
Does formal academic register mean every verb must be passive?
Editor
No — choosing ___ preserves formality while avoiding bureaucratic stiffness.
options: precise active Latinate verbs without slang or contractions
stacked zombie nouns after 'is in receipt of'
complex.explanation: Kesalahpahaman umum mengira tulisan formal harus serba pasif dan kaku ('is in receipt of'). Sebaliknya, kata kerja aktif serapan Latin yang presisi tanpa slang/kontraksi memberi otoritas sekaligus kejelasan tinggi.
hints: Tulisan formal modern tetap memuji kejelasan aktif.
Hindari ungkapan birokratis usang sekaligus bahasa kasual.

complex.prompt: Select the formal replacement for 'A lot of people think we should get rid of single-use cups':
options: Numerous stakeholders advocate eliminating single-use beverage containers.
Loads of folks reckon we ought to dump throwaway cups.
Quite a few people are into getting rid of plastic cups.
complex.explanation: 'Numerous stakeholders advocate eliminating...' memadukan nomina aktor presisi, verb formal + gerund ('advocate eliminating'), dan istilah objek yang jelas.
hints: Cari kalimat yang seluruh kosa kata dan strukturnya konsisten formal.

complex.prompt: Note how preposition stranding shifts in formal style: 'The criteria ___ our panel assessed each submission were published openly.'
complex.explanation: Dalam dokumen hukum/akademik formal, memindahkan preposisi ke depan relative pronoun ('against which') menghindari akhir klausa yang menggantung.
hints: Struktur pied-piping formal meletakkan preposisi sebelum 'which'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan gaya sapaan surat sangat resmi dengan penutup kasual berikut.
complex.draft: Dear Dr. Kusuma, Please find attached the audited balance sheet for Q3. Cheers, Hadi
options: Dear Dr. Kusuma, Please find attached the audited balance sheet for Q3. Sincerely, Hadi
Hi Dr. Kusuma, Please find attached the audited balance sheet for Q3. Yours faithfully, Hadi
Dear Sir/Madam, Enclosed please see the sheet. Best regards from me, Hadi
complex.explanation: 'Dear Dr. Kusuma' (memakai gelar dan nama belakang) tidak cocok ditutup dengan slang akrab 'Cheers,'; karena nama penerima diketahui, penutup profesional baku adalah 'Sincerely,' atau 'Kind regards,'.
hints: Cocokkan tingkat kesopanan pembuka dan penutup surat.
'Cheers' hanya untuk email kasual sesama rekan akrab.

complex.prompt: Replace 'Because of this, prices went up fast' with a high-register academic sentence:
options: Thanks to this, prices shot through the roof.
Because of that, prices got way higher super quick.
complex.explanation: 'Consequently' (konektor sebab-akibat formal) + verb tepat 'escalated rapidly' jauh lebih akademis dan terukur daripada 'went up fast' atau idiom 'shot through the roof'.
hints: Pilih konektor dan verb kenaikan yang serasi untuk register ekonomi.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai verba tunggal 'ascertain' dan subjek impersonal.
complex.targetSentence: Further field measurements are required to ascertain whether aquifer salinity is stabilizing.
complex.explanation: Memakai 'ascertain' (memastikan secara ilmiah) dan 'whether' menjaga gaya riset formal.
hints: Awali dengan 'Further field measurements are required to ascertain'.
Lengkapi klausa 'whether aquifer salinity is stabilizing'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat korespondensi eksekutif yang menolak pengajuan secara diplomatis namun tegas.
complex.targetSentence: We regret that we are unable to approve an extension beyond Friday.
complex.explanation: Formula bisnis formal menolak permintaan dengan sopan ('We regret that we are unable to...').
hints: Mulai dengan 'We regret that we are unable to approve'.
